rows.rationale: Move the binary string model and completed LCS results from WantedExt/Combinatorics/BinaryChvatalSankoffWanted.lean and prove the positivity theorem, preserving their names and statements. Also: Restore the original positivity docstring and credit the literature for the one-bit mean, superadditivity, and convergence in the module documentation. Restate docstrings to match the Lean statements (Atlas wiki audit, #988).
